sub-flow.name: pf-notify
sub-flow.doc:description: Send Slack + optional Jira PR-opened notification. Non-fatal.

http:request.doc:name: POST Slack success notification
http:request.doc:description: Send PR-opened message to the configured Slack channel

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- 'Java 17 upgrade PR opened for ' ++ (vars.appName as String) ++ ' — status PR_OPEN.']
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.jiraCommentText (PR opened)

sub-flow.name: pf-jira-comment
sub-flow.doc:description: Post an ADF comment (with optional link) to a Jira issue. Self-guarding + non-fatal.

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Build Jira ADF comment
ee:transform.doc:description: ADF comment body: summary paragraph + optional link node

http:request.doc:name: POST Jira comment (final decision)
http:request.doc:description: Post the ADF comment to the Jira ticket

sub-flow.name: pf-jira-create-issue
sub-flow.doc:description: Auto-create a Jira migration ticket when none supplied. Self-guarding + non-fatal.

http:request.doc:name: POST create Jira issue
http:request.doc:description: Create the migration issue; response contains the new issue key

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job record for jira update

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Merge jiraTicketId into job record

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- payload mergeWith { jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, updatedAt: nowUtc() }

os:store.doc:name: OS Store job record with jiraTicketId

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN jira create failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'jira auto-create failed, proceeding ticket-less: ' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG jira auto-create skipped
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'jira auto-create skipped (ticket supplied or autoCreate off)']

sub-flow.name: pf-notify-failure
sub-flow.doc:description: Send Slack failure notification. Reads status/error from job record. Non-fatal.

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job record (for failure notification)

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { channel: p('slack.channel'), text: (":x: *Java 17 upgrade FAILED* — " ++ vars.appName ++ "
Job " ++ vars.jobId ++ " • status " ++ vars.failStatus ++ "
Error: " ++ vars.failError ++ (if ((payload.jiraTicketId default null) != null) ("
Jira: <" ++ (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') ++ "/browse/" ++ (payload.jiraTicketId as String) ++ "|" ++ (payload.jiraTicketId as String) ++ ">") else "") ++ (if ((vars.revertPrUrl default "") != "") ("
:leftwards_arrow_with_hook: Rollback PR: " ++ (vars.revertPrUrl as String)) else "")) }

http:request.doc:name: POST Slack failure notification
http:request.doc:description: Send upgrade-failed message to the configured Slack channel

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN failure notification itself failed

sub-flow.name: pf-notify-missing-connectors
sub-flow.doc:description: Slack-alert connectors declared by the app but absent from the matrix. Self-guarding + non-fatal.

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN missing connectors detected
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'MATRIX COVERAGE GAP - app=' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ ' declares connectors missing from the matrix: ' ++ (write((vars.missingConnectors default []), 'application/json', {'indent': false}) as String)]

set-variable.value: #[output text/plain --- 'missingnotify::' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ '::' ++ (((vars.missingConnectors default []) map ((c) -> (c.groupId default '') ++ ':' ++ (c.artifactId default ''))) orderBy $ joinBy ',')]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET missingNotifyKey

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO missing-notify deduped
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'missing-connector alert already sent for this gap, skipping | key=' ++ (vars.missingNotifyKey default '?')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json var list = (vars.missingConnectors default []) map ((c) -> "• " ++ (c.groupId default "?") ++ ":" ++ (c.artifactId default "?")) --- { channel: p('slack.channel'), text: (":warning: *Java 17 matrix coverage gap* — " ++ (vars.appName default "unknown") ++ "
Job " ++ (vars.jobId default "?") ++ "
The app declares connector(s) NOT in the compatibility matrix, so they were *not* pinned for Java 17:
" ++ (list joinBy "
") ++ "
Action: add these to the matrix (connectors:) and republish, then reapply the job.") }

http:request.doc:name: POST Slack missing-connector alert
http:request.doc:description: Send matrix-coverage-gap message to the configured Slack channel

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG no missing connectors
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'no missing connectors to notify (or notifyMissing disabled)']
